```artifact
Feature: System Access and Management

  Scenario Outline: System availability based on PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with the following PinCodes: <pinCodes>
    When a user tries to access the system with PinCode: <pinCode>
    Then the system should <result>
    Examples:
      | pinCodes | pinCode | result |
      | 1234     | 1234    | be available |
      | 5678     | 5678    | be available |
      | 9999     | 9999    | be available |
      | 1235     | 1235    | be unavailable |

  Scenario Outline: User login with valid credentials
    Given the system is configured with the following users:
      | username | password |
      | user1    | pass123  |
    When a user tries to login with username: <username> and password: <password>
    Then the system should <result>
    Examples:
      | username | password | result |
      | user1    | pass123  | allow login |
      | user2    | pass123  | deny login |

  Scenario Outline: User login with invalid credentials
    Given the system is configured with the following users:
      | username | password |
      | user1    | pass123  |
    When a user tries to login with username: <username> and password: <password>
    Then the system should <result>
    Examples:
      | username | password | result |
      | user1    | wrong123 | deny login |
      | user2    | pass123  | deny login |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor-Speciality mapping
    Given the system is configured with the following doctors and specialities:
      | doctorId | specialityId |
      | 1        | 101          |
      | 2        | 102          |
    When a user tries to map doctorId: <doctorId> to specialityId: <specialityId>
    Then the system should <result>
    Examples:
      | doctorId | specialityId | result |
      | 1        | 101          | allow mapping |
      | 2        | 102          | allow mapping |
      | 1        | 103          | deny mapping |
      | 3        | 101          | deny mapping |

  Scenario Outline: Patient registration
    Given the system is configured with the following patients:
      | patientId |
      | 1001      |
    When a user tries to register a new patient with unique id: <patientId>
    Then the system should <result>
    Examples:
      | patientId | result |
      | 1002      | allow registration |
      | 1001      | deny registration |

  Scenario Outline: Patient consultation requests
    Given the system is configured with the following patients and specialities:
      | patientId | specialityId |
      | 1001      | 101          |
    When a user tries to request consultation for patientId: <patientId> for specialityId: <specialityId>
    Then the system should <result>
    Examples:
      | patientId | specialityId | result |
      | 1001      | 101          | allow request |
      | 1001      | 102          | deny request |
```
